name: Musashibou Benkei
source: A former warrior monk of Mt. Hiei. Benkei is a clumsy man who is hardworking and caring. He is a taciturn man who gives a somewhat frightening impression. He is also a reliable mother figure who is pushed around by the self-satisfied Yoshitsune.
